## Product Line with Specifications
### 1. Molded FRP Grating
- Thickness: 25mm, 30mm, 38mm, 50mm
- Mesh: 38x38mm, 40x40mm, 12x12mm (mini mesh)
- Panel size: 1220x3660mm (4'x12') standard
- Resin: Orthophthalic, Isophthalic, Vinyl Ester, Phenolic
- Surface: Concave/meniscus, Grit/quartz, Smooth, Solid cover
- Load capacity: 38mm = 8.0 kN/m² at 1200mm span
- Weight: 38mm = ~13.5 kg/m²
- Colors: 12 standard + custom RAL

### 2. Pultruded FRP Grating
- Types: I-bar, T-bar, heavy-duty
- Thickness: 38mm, 50mm, 60mm, 75mm
- Span capability: up to 3000mm
- Resin: Vinyl ester (standard), Isophthalic
- Surface: Grit top, smooth
- Load capacity: 50mm = 12.0 kN/m² at 1500mm span
- Higher unidirectional strength than molded

### 3. FRP Covers & Panels
- Solid top covers, trench covers, drain covers
- Thickness: 25mm, 30mm, 38mm, 50mm
- Waterproof sealed surface
- Custom sizes available

### 4. FRP Pultruded Profiles
- I-beams, channels, angles, tubes, rods
- Standard and custom shapes
- Vinyl ester and isophthalic options
- Structural grade reinforcement

### 5. FRP Handrail & Stair Systems
- Complete modular systems
- Stair treads, handrails, guardrails
- OSHA-compliant designs
- Easy assembly with stainless steel connectors

### 6. Fiberglass Fabric
- Woven roving, C-glass, E-glass
- Various weights and weaves
- For FRP manufacturing

### 7. Grating Clips & Fasteners
- M-clip (standard), C-clip (edge), Z-clip (heavy-duty)
- SS304 and SS316 stainless steel
- 4 clips per panel recommended

### 8. Custom FRP Solutions
- OEM/ODM manufacturing
- Custom shapes, sizes, colors
- CAD design and engineering support
- Assembly and fabrication services

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Product Questions
Q: What is FRP grating?
A: FRP (Fiber Reinforced Polymer) grating, also known as GRP (Glass Reinforced Plastic) grating, is a lightweight, corrosion-resistant alternative to steel grating. Made from glass fiber reinforced resin, it is used for walkways, platforms, and flooring in corrosive industrial environments. It is 75% lighter than steel, non-conductive, and requires zero maintenance.

Q: What is the difference between molded and pultruded FRP grating?
A: Molded grating has bidirectional equal strength (same strength in both directions) and is easier to cut on-site. Pultruded grating has higher unidirectional strength and longer span capability, making it ideal for heavy-load applications with wide support spacing.

Q: What thicknesses are available?
A: Standard thicknesses are 25mm (light traffic), 30mm (standard walkways), 38mm (industrial platforms, most popular), and 50mm (heavy-duty areas). Custom thicknesses available.

Q: What resin systems do you offer?
A: Four resin systems: (1) Orthophthalic polyester - general purpose, lowest cost; (2) Isophthalic polyester - wastewater, general chemical resistance; (3) Vinyl ester - strong acid/alkali, marine, offshore, highest corrosion resistance; (4) Phenolic - fire retardant, low smoke, zero halogen.

Q: What surface options are available?
A: Four standard surfaces: (1) Concave/meniscus - standard, R9-R10 slip resistance; (2) Grit/quartz - maximum slip resistance R13, for oily/wet areas; (3) Smooth - polished, easy to clean; (4) Solid cover - waterproof sealed top.

Q: What colors are available?
A: 12 standard colors: gray, yellow, green, blue, red, orange, beige, black, white, brown, tan, dark gray. Custom RAL color matching available for large orders. Color is integrated throughout the material, never needs painting.

Q: Can FRP grating be cut on-site?
A: Yes, FRP grating can be cut with standard tools (circular saw, jigsaw, handsaw). No special equipment needed. Seal cut edges with resin for corrosion protection.

### Pricing & Ordering
Q: What is the price of FRP grating?
A: Prices range from $45-90/m² depending on thickness, resin type, and quantity. Polyester is lowest cost, vinyl ester is 30-50% higher. ZEALL pricing is 40-60% lower than Fibergrate and Strongwell. Contact sales@gratingfrp.com for exact quotation.

Q: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
A: Our MOQ is 1 piece. We welcome both small and large orders.

Q: What is the lead time?
A: Standard products: 15-20 days. Custom fabrication: 20-25 days. Faster than leading brands (30-45 days).

Q: Can I get a quotation within 24 hours?
A: Yes, our sales and engineering team provides quotations within 24 working hours. Send your specifications to sales@gratingfrp.com.

### Engineering & Technical
Q: Do you provide structural calculations?
A: Yes, our in-house engineering team provides free structural calculations, load/span analysis, and material recommendations.

Q: Do you provide CAD drawings?
A: Yes, we provide CAD drawings (DWG, DXF) for custom fabrication projects.

Q: What fire ratings do you offer?
A: Tested per ASTM E-84: Polyester = Class C (FSI ~100-150), Vinyl ester = Class B-C, Phenolic = Class A (FSI <25) with low smoke and zero halogen.

Q: What is the lifespan of FRP grating?
A: With proper resin selection, FRP grating lasts 20+ years in corrosive environments. ZEALL offers 20+ year warranty.

Q: How does FRP grating compare to steel?
A: FRP is 75% lighter, corrosion-proof, non-conductive, and requires zero maintenance. Over 20 years, FRP saves 40-60% compared to steel (including painting, rust removal, and replacement).

Q: What is the load capacity of FRP grating?
A: 38mm molded grating supports 8.0 kN/m² uniform load at 1200mm span. 50mm heavy-duty supports 12.0 kN/m² at 1500mm span. Pultruded grating supports higher loads and longer spans up to 3000mm.

### Installation & Maintenance
Q: How is FRP grating installed?
A: Place panels on support beams, fasten with grating clips (M-clip, C-clip, Z-clip) using stainless steel bolts. Typically 4 clips per panel. No welding required.

Q: What types of clips do you offer?
A: M-clip (standard top mounting), C-clip (edge mounting), Z-clip (heavy-duty). Available in SS304 and SS316 stainless steel.

Q: How do I clean FRP grating?
A: Pressure washing with water or mild detergent. Steam cleaning up to 120°C. Avoid abrasive cleaners and solvents.

Q: Does FRP grating need painting?
A: No, FRP grating never needs painting. Color is integrated throughout the material. This is a major cost-saving advantage over steel.

### Applications by Industry
Q: What industries use FRP grating?
A: Wastewater treatment, chemical processing, oil & gas, offshore & marine, power generation, mining, food & beverage, pharmaceutical, pulp & paper, transportation, solar energy, car wash, cooling towers, shipbuilding, municipal engineering.

Q: Is FRP grating suitable for offshore platforms?
A: Yes, vinyl ester FRP grating with UV stabilizers and SS316 clips is ideal for offshore platforms. Resistant to saltwater corrosion and UV exposure. Fire-retardant options available.

Q: Is FRP grating suitable for wastewater treatment plants?
A: Yes, FRP grating is the standard for wastewater plants due to H2S and chemical resistance. Isophthalic or vinyl ester resin recommended.

Q: Can FRP grating be used in food processing plants?
A: Yes, food-grade resin options are available. Smooth or grit surfaces for wash-down areas.

Q: Is FRP grating suitable for chemical plants?
A: Yes, vinyl ester FRP grating is designed for strong acid and alkali environments. Chemical resistance charts available for specific chemicals.

Q: Is FRP grating suitable for mining operations?
A: Yes, FRP grating is non-conductive, corrosion-resistant, and lightweight, making it ideal for mining walkways, platforms, and sumps.
